items.title_cn: 基于机器学习的急性胰腺炎相关肝损伤早期预测模型的开发及单中心时间验证
items.title_en: Development and a single-centre temporal validation of a machine learning-based model for early prediction of acute pancreatitis-associated liver injury
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见的急性腹部炎症性疾病，以胰酶过早激活为特征，导致胰腺自身消化、水肿、出血甚至坏死。肝脏作为接收胰腺静脉回流的第一道门静脉器官，是AP中最常受累的胰腺外器官之一。AP相关肝损伤（LI）与全身炎症强度、多器官功能障碍的发生及死亡率增加密切相关。尽管机器学习（ML）模型已成功应用于预测各种AP相关并发症，如急性呼吸窘迫综合征、急性肾损伤和感染性胰腺坏死，但在LI临床发作前对其进行早期预测的有效工具仍然缺乏。我们回顾性收集了2018年1月至2023年12月期间在河南科技大学第一附属医院诊断为AP的1，184例患者的数据。经过严格的纳入和排除标准筛选后，共纳入1，124例患者。开发队列由2018年1月至2022年12月期间入院的929例患者组成，按7：3比例随机分为训练集（n = 650）和内部测试集（n = 279）。独立的时间验证集由2023年1月至12月入院的195例患者组成。收集入院24小时内的49项临床和实验室参数，用于预测住院前24小时后发生的LI。入院24小时内任何ALT/AST升高> 3×ULN的患者不计为LI事件；结局严格定义为24小时后新发的LI。在训练集中，使用LASSO回归识别关键预测因素，随后构建九种机器学习模型：逻辑回归（LR）、决策树（DT）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost和LightGBM等。所有特征选择和超参数调优均仅在训练集上通过5折交叉验证进行嵌套，未使用测试集或验证集信息。模型性能主要采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、校准指标（Brier评分、校准截距/斜率）和决策曲线分析（DCA）进行评估。采用SHAP方法对最优模型进行可解释性分析。LASSO回归识别出十个关键预测因素：淀粉酶（AMY）、脂肪酶（LIP）、总胆固醇（CHO）、白蛋白（ALB）、中性粒细胞百分比（N/W）、血清钙（Ca）、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）、性别、总胆红素（TBIL）和饮酒史。在九种模型中，随机森林（RF）模型表现出优越的预测性能和时间泛化能力，在内部测试集中AUC为0.972（95% CI：0.954–0.989），准确率为0.921；在时间验证集中AUC为0.935（95% CI：0.902–0.969），准确率为0.862。RF模型的训练-测试AUC差距为0.028（1.000 vs. 0.972），表明存在轻度过拟合。决策曲线分析证实了在多个阈值范围内具有净临床获益。SHAP分析显示，胰酶（AMY、LIP）和反映肝脏合成功能的标志物（ALB、CHO）是影响模型输出的主要预测因素。校准可接受，测试集和验证集的Brier评分分别为0.070和0.101；校准斜率分别为2.153（测试集）和1.367（验证集），表明预测概率存在过度离散（过度自信），在临床使用前需要获益于事后重新校准。使用入院24小时内收集的常规临床数据构建的RF模型能够有效预测AP患者肝损伤的风险，并展现出良好的时间泛化能力。该模型为早期识别高危患者提供了一种潜在有用的工具；然而，在临床实施前需要进行前瞻性外部验证和概率重新校准。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common acute abdominal inflammatory disorder characterized by premature activation of pancreatic enzymes, leading to pancreatic autodigestion, edema, hemorrhage, and even necrosis. The liver, as the first portal organ receiving pancreatic venous drainage, is one of the most frequently affected extra-pancreatic organs in AP. AP-associated liver injury (LI) is closely correlated with the intensity of systemic inflammation, the development of multiple organ dysfunction, and increased mortality. While machine learning (ML) models have been successfully applied to predict various AP-related complications such as acute respiratory distress syndrome, acute kidney injury, and infected pancreatic necrosis, effective tools for early prediction of LI before its clinical onset remain lacking. We retrospectively collected data from 1,184 patients diagnosed with AP at the First Affiliated Hospital of Henan University of Science and Technology between January 2018 and December 2023. After applying strict inclusion and exclusion criteria, 1,124 patients were included. The development cohort comprised 929 patients admitted between January 2018 and December 2022, randomly split into a training set (n = 650) and an internal test set (n = 279) in a 7:3 ratio. An independent temporal validation set consisted of 195 patients admitted from January to December 2023. Forty-nine clinical and laboratory parameters were collected within 24 h of admission to predict LI occurring after the first 24 h of hospitalization. Patients with any ALT/AST elevation > 3×ULN within the first 24 h were not counted as LI events; the outcome was strictly defined as incident LI emerging after 24 h. In the training set, LASSO regression was used to identify key predictive factors, followed by the construction of nine machine learning models: logistic regression (LR), decision trees (DT), random forests (RF), XGBoost, and LightGBM, among others. All feature selection and hyperparameter tuning were nested within 5-fold cross-validation on the training set only, with no use of test or validation set information. Model performance was primarily assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration metrics (Brier score, calibration intercept/slope), and decision-curve analysis (DCA). The SHAP method was employed for interpretability analysis of the optimal model. LASSO regression identified ten key predictors: amylase (AMY), lipase (LIP), total cholesterol (CHO), albumin (ALB), neutrophil percentage (N/W), serum calcium (Ca), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), gender, total bilirubin (TBIL), and drinking history. Among the nine models, the random forest (RF) model demonstrated superior predictive performance and temporal generalizability, achieving an AUC of 0.972 (95% CI: 0.954–0.989) with an accuracy of 0.921 in the internal test set, and an AUC of 0.935 (95% CI: 0.902–0.969) with an accuracy of 0.862 in the temporal validation set. The RF model showed a training–test AUC gap of 0.028 (1.000 vs. 0.972), indicating modest overfitting. Decision-curve analysis confirmed net clinical benefit across a range of thresholds. SHAP analysis revealed that pancreatic enzymes (AMY, LIP) and markers reflecting hepatic synthetic function (ALB, CHO) were the primary predictors influencing the model’s output. Calibration was acceptable, with Brier scores of 0.070 and 0.101 in the test and validation sets, respectively; calibration slopes were 2.153 (test) and 1.367 (validation), indicating over-dispersion of predicted probabilities (over-confidence) that would benefit from post-hoc recalibration before clinical use. An RF model built using routine clinical data collected within 24 h of admission can effectively predict the risk of liver injury in AP patients and demonstrates promising temporal generalizability. The model offers a potentially useful tool for early identification of high-risk patients; however, prospective external validation and probability recalibration are required before clinical implementation.
items.summary_cn: 该研究基于AP患者入院24小时内的常规临床和实验室数据，构建了9种机器学习模型以早期预测急性胰腺炎相关肝损伤，其中随机森林模型表现最佳，内部测试集AUC为0.972，时间验证集AUC为0.935；SHAP分析显示胰酶（AMY、LIP）和反映肝脏合成功能的标志物（ALB、CHO）是主要预测因子。

items.title_cn: 靶向PGAM5-Drp1轴调控线粒体动力学并抑制重症急性胰腺炎胰腺腺泡细胞坏死性凋亡
items.title_en: Targeting PGAM5-Drp1 axis modulates mitochondrial dynamics and inhibits pancreatic acinar cell necroptosis in severe acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 目的 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）是一种以广泛胰腺坏死和失控炎症为特征的高死亡率疾病。线粒体功能障碍和胰腺腺泡细胞（PACs）坏死性凋亡是SAP的关键病理事件，而线粒体蛋白磷酸甘油酸变位酶家族成员5（PGAM5）在SAP中的作用尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨PGAM5在SAP发病机制中的功能及机制。方法 检测SAP小鼠胰腺组织及临床胰腺炎样本中PGAM5的表达。采用生物信息学分析鉴定线粒体动力学和坏死性凋亡通路的改变。体外实验中，在PACs中进行PGAM5敲低，以检测动力相关蛋白1（Drp1）介导的线粒体分裂、线粒体功能、活性氧（ROS）蓄积及细胞坏死性凋亡。验证PGAM5与Drp1之间的直接相互作用。体内实验中，应用PGAM5特异性抑制剂评估SAP小鼠的胰腺损伤。结果 PGAM5表达在SAP小鼠组织和人胰腺炎样本中均显著上调。PGAM5敲低抑制了Drp1介导的线粒体分裂，恢复了线粒体膜电位，减少了ROS蓄积，并抑制了PACs坏死性凋亡。PGAM5与Drp1之间存在直接结合相互作用。体内抑制PGAM5可有效减轻SAP小鼠的胰腺损伤。结论 PGAM5–Drp1轴诱导线粒体功能障碍并促进PACs坏死性凋亡，从而促进SAP进展。与既往主要关注下游炎症和坏死性凋亡信号的研究不同，本研究将PGAM5–Drp1轴与SAP相关线粒体损伤相关联，为SAP干预提供了潜在靶点。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Objective Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is a high-mortality disease characterized by extensive pancreatic necrosis and uncontrolled inflammation. Mitochondrial dysfunction and pancreatic acinar cells (PACs) necroptosis are critical pathological events in SAP, while the role of the mitochondrial protein phosphoglycerate mutase family member 5 (PGAM5) in SAP remains poorly defined. This study aimed to explore the function and mechanism of PGAM5 in SAP pathogenesis. Methods PGAM5 expression was examined in pancreatic tissues of SAP mice and clinical pancreatitis samples. Bioinformatics analysis was used to identify alterations in mitochondrial dynamics and necroptosis pathways. In vitro, PGAM5 knockdown was performed in PACs to detect dynamin-related protein 1 (Drp1)-mediated mitochondrial fission, mitochondrial function, reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation and cell necroptosis. The direct interaction between PGAM5 and Drp1 was validated. In vivo, a PGAM5-specific inhibitor was applied to evaluate pancreatic injury in SAP mice. Results PGAM5 expression was significantly upregulated in both SAP mouse tissues and human pancreatitis samples. PGAM5 knockdown inhibited Drp1-mediated mitochondrial fission, restored mitochondrial membrane potential, decreased ROS accumulation, and suppressed PACs necroptosis. A direct binding interaction existed between PGAM5 and Drp1. In vivo inhibition of PGAM5 effectively alleviated pancreatic injury in SAP mice. Conclusions The PGAM5–Drp1 axis induces mitochondrial dysfunction and promotes PACs necroptosis, thereby contributing to SAP progression. Unlike previous studies focused mainly on downstream inflammatory and necroptotic signaling, the present work associates the PGAM5–Drp1 axis with SAP-related mitochondrial damage, providing a potential target for SAP intervention.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现PGAM5在SAP小鼠胰腺组织和人类胰腺炎样本中显著上调，PGAM5敲低可抑制Drp1介导的线粒体分裂、恢复线粒体膜电位、减少ROS积累并抑制胰腺腺泡细胞坏死性凋亡，且PGAM5与Drp1存在直接结合；体内抑制PGAM5可有效减轻SAP小鼠胰腺损伤。

items.title_cn: 高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎合并盲肠后位阑尾炎：一例报告
items.title_en: Hypertriglyceridemic Acute Pancreatitis With Concomitant Retrocecal Appendicitis: A Case Report
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 高甘油三酯血症诱发的急性胰腺炎与急性阑尾炎是两种不同的临床疾病，二者同时发生的报道极为罕见。我们报告一例高甘油三酯血症诱发的胰腺炎，其特点是尽管血清甘油三酯水平下降，临床症状仍持续恶化。虽然初始影像学检查显示胰腺炎症征象，但急诊探查性剖腹术发现合并盲肠后位阑尾炎，并并发盆腔脓肿。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Hypertriglyceridemia‐induced acute pancreatitis and acute appendicitis are distinct clinical conditions rarely reported to occur concurrently. We present a case of hypertriglyceridemia‐induced pancreatitis characterized by clinical deterioration despite a decline in serum triglyceride levels. While initial imaging demonstrated pancreatic inflammatory signatures, emergent exploratory laparotomy revealed a concomitant retrocecal appendicitis complicated by a pelvic abscess.
items.summary_cn: 本文报道了一例高甘油三酯血症诱导的急性胰腺炎患者，尽管血清甘油三酯水平下降但临床仍恶化，急诊探查手术发现合并盲肠后位阑尾炎并盆腔脓肿。该病例提示急性胰腺炎可能同时存在罕见的阑尾炎并发症，需警惕临床恶化与影像学不一致的情况。

items.title_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎外周血整合转录组分析识别NETosis相关程序及分层适应性免疫抑制模式
items.title_en: Integrative transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood identifies NETosis-associated programs and a stratified adaptive immune suppression pattern in severe acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 背景：重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）与持续性器官衰竭和显著死亡率相关，然而从轻症急性胰腺炎向重症谱系疾病进展的转录组学机制仍未完全阐明。早期识别有持续性器官衰竭风险的患者仍是一个重要的未满足临床需求。方法：我们对来自GSE194331的外周血RNA-seq数据进行了整合转录组学分析（健康对照[HC]，n = 32；轻症急性胰腺炎[MAP]，n = 57；重症谱系AP组[SAP组]，n = 30，包括MSAP n = 20和重症AP n = 10；入院24小时内采样）。建立了双重比较框架，使用SAP vs HC和SAP vs MAP以区分广泛的AP相关变化与器官衰竭相关特征。整合了基因集富集分析（GSEA）、基于ssGSEA的免疫特征分析、三算法机器学习（LASSO、随机森林和SVM-RFE）以及加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），以识别候选基因并表征相关生物学程序。来自大鼠回肠组织的跨物种单细胞RNA-seq数据（GSE244963）仅用作候选基因的支持性细胞类型背景。结果：GSEA在SAP组中鉴定出NETosis、补体/凝血、氧化磷酸化以及多种炎症性细胞死亡相关程序的富集。ssGSEA揭示了适应性免疫相关特征的降低，其中CD8 + T细胞和NK细胞特征在MAP中已经降低，而CD4 + T细胞和Treg相关特征在SAP中相对于MAP显示出进一步降低。三算法机器学习识别出三个核心候选基因及其发现队列AUC值：MRPL51（ML-A，SAP vs HC，AUC = 0.951）、C1QA（ML-B，SAP vs MAP，AUC = 0.754）和DACT1（ML-B，SAP vs MAP，AUC = 0.758）。重复分层5折交叉验证支持单基因估计的内部稳定性，但无独立外部验证队列可用。中性粒细胞相关的NETosis基因三联体（OLFM4、LTF和CEACAM6）在ML-B中 additionally被LASSO和随机森林共同选中。大鼠回肠scRNA-seq提供了支持性的跨物种细胞类型背景，而非确定性验证。结论：外周血的整合转录组学分析识别出候选转录组标志物，并提示与AP严重程度进展相关的中性粒细胞相关、代谢和适应性免疫程序。分层适应性免疫特征降低模式及NETosis相关基因三联体可能代表从轻症AP向重症谱系AP组进展的发现级转录组特征。需要在前瞻性人类队列中进行独立验证。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is associated with persistent organ failure and substantial mortality, yet the transcriptomic mechanisms underlying progression from mild acute pancreatitis to severe-spectrum disease remain incompletely defined. Early identification of patients at risk of persistent organ failure remains an important unmet clinical need. METHODS: We performed an integrative transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood RNA-seq data from GSE194331 (healthy controls [HC], n = 32; mild acute pancreatitis [MAP], n = 57; severe-spectrum AP group [SAP group], n = 30, comprising MSAP n = 20 and severe AP n = 10; sampled within 24 hours of admission). A dual-comparison framework was established using SAP vs HC and SAP vs MAP to distinguish broad AP-associated changes from organ failure-associated features. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), ssGSEA-based immune signature analysis, triple-algorithm machine learning (LASSO, random forest, and SVM-RFE), and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) were integrated to identify candidate genes and characterize associated biological programs. Cross-species single-cell RNA-seq data from rat ileal tissue (GSE244963) were used only as supportive cell-type context for candidate genes. RESULTS: GSEA identified enrichment of NETosis, complement/coagulation, oxidative phosphorylation, and multiple inflammatory cell death-related programs in the SAP group. ssGSEA revealed reduced adaptive immune-associated signatures, with CD8 + T-cell and NK-cell signatures already reduced in MAP and CD4 + T-cell and Treg-associated signatures showing additional reduction in SAP relative to MAP. Triple-algorithm machine learning identified three core candidate genes with discovery-cohort AUC values: MRPL51 (ML-A, SAP vs HC, AUC = 0.951), C1QA (ML-B, SAP vs MAP, AUC = 0.754), and DACT1 (ML-B, SAP vs MAP, AUC = 0.758). Repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation supported internal stability of the single-gene estimates, but no independent external validation cohort was available. A neutrophil-associated NETosis gene triad (OLFM4, LTF, and CEACAM6) was additionally co-selected by LASSO and random forest in ML-B. Rat ileal scRNA-seq provided supportive, cross-species cell-type context rather than definitive validation. CONCLUSION: Integrative transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood identifies candidate transcriptomic markers and suggests neutrophil-associated, metabolic, and adaptive immune programs associated with AP severity progression. The stratified adaptive immune signature reduction pattern and the NETosis-associated gene triad may represent discovery-level transcriptomic features of progression from mild AP to the severe-spectrum AP group. Independent validation in prospective human cohorts is required.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过外周血转录组整合分析，发现重症急性胰腺炎中NETosis、补体/凝血及氧化磷酸化等程序富集，并揭示适应性免疫抑制的分层模式（CD8+T和NK细胞信号在MAP即降低，CD4+T和Treg信号在SAP进一步降低）；机器学习筛选出MRPL51、C1QA、DACT1三个候选基因，以及中性粒细胞相关NETosis基因三联体（OLFM4、LTF、CEACAM6）。

items.title_cn: CD20阳性B细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤伴复发性急性胰腺炎、双侧肾脏病变及腹膜后淋巴结肿大
items.title_en: CD20-Positive B-Cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma Associated With Recurrent Acute Pancreatitis, Bilateral Renal Lesions, and Retroperitoneal Lymphadenopathy
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题报道了一例CD20阳性B细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤，表现为复发性急性胰腺炎、双侧肾脏病变及腹膜后淋巴结肿大。摘要未提供，仅从标题可知其关联急性胰腺炎与淋巴瘤的罕见病因。

items.title_cn: 从被动封堵到主动微环境重塑：多功能水凝胶预防术后胰瘘的设计策略、生物学效应与转化挑战
items.title_en: From passive sealing to active microenvironment remodeling: design strategies, biological effects, and translational challenges of multifunctional hydrogels for postoperative pancreatic fistula prevention
items.abstract_cn: 术后胰瘘（POPF）仍是胰腺手术后最常见且潜在致命的并发症之一，报道的发生率范围为20%至64%。传统封堵材料——包括纤维蛋白胶和聚乙醇酸毡——在富含蛋白酶的胰腺微环境中面临快速降解和湿态条件下粘附丧失的问题，导致早期阳性随机试验与后续阴性荟萃分析之间存在显著矛盾。近年来，多功能水凝胶正在推动POPF预防从“被动物理屏障”向“主动微环境重塑”的理念转变。本综述从多个维度审视了针对术后胰腺极端微环境量身定制的水凝胶设计策略：在酶管理领域，我们比较了基于D-氨基酸肽的主动酶捕获策略、使用重组胶原的酶切位点消除策略以及自组装肽的结构耐受策略；在结构-功能一体化方面，我们分析了不对称双层设计如何同时实现湿组织密封和抗粘连；在功能集成方面，我们描绘了PVA基平台从纯物理屏障到抗菌/抗炎/促愈合多功能复合材料的演化轨迹；在时间维度上，我们评估了创新治疗框架，包括“全周期管理”以及POPF预防与肿瘤免疫治疗的双功能整合。我们进一步从五个视角对关键转化差距进行了批判性分析：动物模型中的物种差异、降解动力学与吻合口愈合窗口的定量匹配、外科可操作性、可规模化制造与灭菌，以及诊疗闭环。在所综述的研究中，所有治疗性多功能水凝胶仍处于概念验证阶段，主要在大鼠模型中进行，而SmartPAN——一种诊断性渗漏指示器——是唯一进入人体试验的POPF相关水凝胶器械。建立标准化的胰液耐受性评估体系、在大动物模型中验证长期疗效和安全性，以及实现降解动力学与吻合口愈合时间线之间的精确定量匹配，是推动该领域临床转化最为紧迫的任务。
items.abstract_en: Postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) remains one of the most common and potentially lethal complications following pancreatic surgery, with reported incidence rates ranging from 20% to 64%. Conventional sealing materials—including fibrin glue and polyglycolic acid felt—face rapid degradation in the protease-rich pancreatic microenvironment and loss of adhesion in wet conditions, resulting in a marked contradiction between early positive randomized trials and subsequent negative meta-analyses. In recent years, multifunctional hydrogels have been driving a conceptual transition from “passive physical barriers” to “active microenvironment remodeling” for POPF prevention. This review examines hydrogel design strategies tailored to the extreme postoperative pancreatic microenvironment across multiple dimensions: in the domain of enzyme management, we compare the active enzyme-capturing strategy based on D-amino acid peptides, the enzyme-cleavage-site-elimination strategy using recombinant collagen, and the structural tolerance strategy of self-assembling peptides; in structural-functional integration, we analyze how asymmetric bilayer designs simultaneously achieve wet tissue sealing and anti-adhesion; in functional integration, we delineate the evolutionary trajectory of PVA-based platforms from pure physical barriers to antibacterial/anti-inflammatory/pro-healing multifunctional composites; and in the temporal dimension, we evaluate innovative therapeutic frameworks including “full-cycle management” and dual-functional integration of POPF prevention with tumor immunotherapy. We further provide a critical analysis of key translational gaps from five perspectives: species disparities in animal models, quantitative matching of degradation kinetics with anastomotic healing windows, surgical handlability, scalable manufacturing and sterilization, and the diagnostic-therapeutic closed loop. Among the studies reviewed, all therapeutic multifunctional hydrogels remain at the proof-of-concept stage, predominantly in rat models, with SmartPAN—a diagnostic leak indicator—being the only POPF-related hydrogel device to have entered human trials. Establishing standardized pancreatic juice tolerance assessment systems, validating long-term efficacy and safety in large animal models, and achieving precise quantitative matching between degradation kinetics and anastomotic healing timelines represent the most urgent tasks for advancing clinical translation in this field.
items.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了多功能水凝胶用于术后胰瘘预防的设计策略，涵盖酶管理、结构-功能整合、功能集成及时间维度等方向，并指出当前所有治疗性多功能水凝胶仍处于概念验证阶段，仅SmartPAN进入人体试验，标准化胰液耐受评估、大动物长期验证及降解动力学与吻合口愈合窗口的精准匹配是最紧迫的转化任务。

items.title_cn: OmiCoreTumorDetector：一种用于结直肠癌H&E切片肿瘤区域定位的开放式分子验证模型
items.title_en: OmiCoreTumorDetector: an open, molecularly validated model for mapping tumour regions in colorectal cancer H&E sections
items.abstract_cn: 在苏木精-伊红（H&E）切片上定义肿瘤区域是空间组学研究中的常规第一步，然而这一步骤通常由人工完成，且难以重复。我们提出OmiCoreTumorDetector，这是一个开放许可的模型，能够在结直肠癌（CRC）H&E切片中映射肿瘤富集区域，并将其导出为QuPath兼容的注释。所发布的模型（omicore-tumordetector-crc-he-v0.1）是由三个卷积分类器组成的集成模型，在100,000个公共组织图像块上训练，并在推理时结合Macenko染色归一化。在开发过程中我们发现，阻碍复用的主要障碍是染色域偏移下的校准问题，而非判别能力：单一模型在未见过的切片上保持了0.955的ROC曲线下面积（AUROC），但在传统0.5阈值下的灵敏度降至0.48。在未归一化的图像块上训练使独立采集图像块集上的肿瘤AUROC从0.836提升至0.992，而在推理时进行归一化使正常邻近组织中的假阳性肿瘤面积减少了16至26倍。在五张与训练数据无任何材料重叠的10x Visium HD CRC切片上，所发布的模型在三张癌切片中将27.7-48.5%的组织判定为肿瘤，在两张正常邻近切片中分别为0.08%和1.82%，且未从任何正常切片中导出肿瘤区域。在具有匹配单细胞分辨率转录组学的癌切片上，与转录组衍生的肿瘤细胞身份的一致性达到AUROC 0.985（95%空间块自助法CI 0.975-0.993）。该图像模型从未观测基因表达，因此这是正交证据。该模型以112微米分辨率定位肿瘤富集区域；它不能识别单个恶性细胞，且尚未跨扫描仪、机构或组织学变异体进行验证。代码、权重和评估以Apache-2.0许可发布，可通过pip install omicoretumordetector安装。
items.abstract_en: Defining tumour regions on haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) sections is a routine first step in spatial-omics studies, yet it is usually done by hand and is difficult to reproduce. We present OmiCoreTumorDetector, an openly licensed model that maps tumour-enriched regions in colorectal cancer (CRC) H&E sections and exports them as QuPath-compatible annotations. The released model (omicore-tumordetector-crc-he-v0.1) is an ensemble of three convolutional classifiers trained on 100,000 public tissue tiles, combined with Macenko stain normalisation at inference. During development we found that the main obstacle to reuse was calibration under stain-domain shift rather than discrimination: a single model kept an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of 0.955 on unseen slides while its sensitivity at the conventional 0.5 threshold fell to 0.48. Training on non-normalised tiles raised tumour AUROC on an independently collected tile set from 0.836 to 0.992, and normalising at inference reduced false-positive tumour area in normal-adjacent tissue by 16- to 26-fold. On five 10x Visium HD CRC sections that share no material with the training data, the released model called 27.7-48.5% of tissue as tumour in three carcinoma sections and 0.08% and 1.82% in two normal-adjacent sections, exporting no tumour region from either normal section. On the carcinoma section with matched single-cell-resolution transcriptomics, agreement with transcriptome-derived tumour-cell identities reached an AUROC of 0.985 (95% spatial-block bootstrap CI 0.975-0.993). The image model never observes gene expression, so this is orthogonal evidence. The model localises tumour-enriched regions at 112 um resolution; it does not identify individual malignant cells and has not yet been validated across scanners, institutions or histological variants. Code, weights and evaluation are released under Apache-2.0 and installable with pip install omicoretumordetector.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发布了OmiCoreTumorDetector，一个开放许可的模型，用于在结直肠癌H&E切片中映射肿瘤富集区域并导出QuPath兼容注释，其核心发现是染色域偏移下的校准而非判别是复用的主要障碍，通过非归一化切片训练和推理时归一化可显著提升肿瘤AUROC并减少正常邻近组织中的假阳性。该模型在独立Visium HD切片上与转录组来源的肿瘤细胞身份一致性AUROC达0.985，但仅定位112微米分辨率的肿瘤富集区域，不识别单个恶性细胞，尚未跨扫描仪、机构或组织学变异验证。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
